text:
### Step 5: Merchant/Third-Party Investigation  
**If Fraud Involves External Merchant/Recipient:**  
**For Card Transactions:**
- Contact merchant for transaction proof
- Request proof customer was present (if card-present)
- Request merchant records (receipt, camera footage)
- Review merchant chargeback history (are they repeat offender?)  
**For Transfers to External Account:**
- Identify recipient bank
- Request transaction details (recipient name matches account?)
- Track recipient account (is it in sanctions list? Multiple fraud reports?)
- Identify if funds already withdrawn  
**Timeline:**
- If funds still in recipient account: Attempt to recover (urgent)
- If funds withdrawn: Trace withdrawal location (law enforcement)

raw_entities.name: Merchant/Third-Party Investigation
raw_entities.description: A fraud investigation step triggered when fraudulent activity involves an external merchant or third-party recipient. The step branches into two paths: card transaction investigation (merchant contact, proof of presence, receipt/footage review, chargeback history) and transfer investigation (recipient bank identification, account verification, sanctions screening, fund recovery tracking).
context: Track recipient account (is it in sanctions list? Multiple fraud reports?)

raw_entities.name: Card Transaction Merchant Contact
raw_entities.description: A sub-step within merchant investigation specific to card transactions. Involves contacting the merchant to obtain transaction proof, evidence of customer presence (for card-present transactions), and merchant records including receipts and camera footage.
context: Request proof customer was present (if card-present)

raw_entities.name: Merchant Chargeback History Review
raw_entities.description: An investigation step that reviews the merchant's chargeback history to identify whether the merchant is a repeat offender in fraud cases, informing the fraud assessment and recovery strategy.
context: Review merchant chargeback history (are they repeat offender?)

raw_entities.name: External Account Transfer Investigation
raw_entities.description: A sub-step within merchant investigation specific to transfers to external accounts. Involves identifying the recipient bank, requesting transaction details, verifying recipient name matches the account, screening the recipient account against sanctions lists, and checking for multiple fraud reports.
context: Request transaction details (recipient name matches account?)
Track recipient account (is it in sanctions list? Multiple fraud reports?)

raw_entities.name: Recipient Account Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: A compliance check within transfer investigation that screens the recipient account against sanctions lists to determine if the account is linked to sanctioned entities or high-risk parties.
context: Track recipient account (is it in sanctions list? Multiple fraud reports?)

raw_entities.name: Fund Recovery Attempt
raw_entities.description: An urgent investigation step executed when fraudulent funds remain in the recipient account. Involves immediate contact with the recipient bank to attempt recovery of the transferred funds.
context: If funds still in recipient account: Attempt to recover (urgent)

raw_entities.name: Withdrawal Location Tracing
raw_entities.description: An investigation step executed when fraudulent funds have already been withdrawn from the recipient account. Involves tracing the withdrawal location and escalating to law enforcement for further investigation.
context: If funds withdrawn: Trace withdrawal location (law enforcement)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Involves External Merchant or Third Party
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that determines whether the fraud involves an external merchant or third-party recipient, triggering the Merchant/Third-Party Investigation process. If yes, the investigation branches into card transaction or transfer-specific paths.

raw_entities.name: Funds Status in Recipient Account
raw_entities.description: A critical decision point that determines whether fraudulent funds remain in the recipient account or have been withdrawn. If funds remain, urgent recovery is attempted; if withdrawn, the case is escalated to law enforcement for withdrawal location tracing.
context: If funds still in recipient account: Attempt to recover (urgent)
If funds withdrawn: Trace withdrawal location (law enforcement)

raw_entities.name: External Merchant Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: A fraud investigation triggered by fraudulent activity involving an external merchant or third-party recipient. The investigation encompasses merchant contact, proof verification, chargeback history review, and fund recovery or law enforcement escalation depending on fund status.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening for Recipient Account
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate that screens the recipient account against sanctions lists during fraud investigation of external transfers. Verifies whether the recipient account is linked to sanctioned entities or has multiple fraud reports.
context: Track recipient account (is it in sanctions list? Multiple fraud reports?)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Team
raw_entities.description: The operational role responsible for executing merchant/third-party fraud investigations, including contacting merchants, requesting documentation, reviewing chargeback history, identifying recipient banks, and coordinating fund recovery or law enforcement escalation.

raw_entities.description: The external merchant entity responsible for providing transaction proof, evidence of customer presence, receipts, camera footage, and chargeback history information during fraud investigation.

raw_entities.description: The external financial institution holding the recipient account. Responsible for providing transaction details, verifying recipient account information, and cooperating with fund recovery attempts when fraudulent transfers are identified.

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement
raw_entities.description: External law enforcement authority engaged when fraudulent funds have been withdrawn from the recipient account. Responsible for tracing withdrawal locations and pursuing criminal investigation.
